objective: Build the first verified Project Aurora vertical slice: an original Godot 4 local platform-fighter prototype with authorized Marvel/DC character references, deterministic movement and combat, two local players, one original stage, stocks, respawn, and headless validation.

tasks.description: Read docs/design and the existing scripts, and confirm the design baseline. Identify contradictions or missing implementation decisions and report them in your structured result (this task is read-only; it must not create or modify files).

Review and complete the existing foundation (scripts/core/Game.gd, MatchSimulation.gd, scripts/input/InputRouter.gd, scenes/Main.tscn): match lifecycle, input abstraction, pause, restart, and debug state display. Follow docs/design/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/design/TESTING_STRATEGY.md, keep the simulation independent of the scene tree (DEC-009), and add tests to tests/run_tests.gd.
Review the foundation implementation against the architecture and testing specifications. Identify lifecycle, input, pause, restart, resource-loading, and test gaps.

Extend the deterministic movement in scripts/core/FighterState.gd (or extract it into scripts/movement) to cover the rest of docs/design/MOVEMENT_SPEC.md: fast fall, down-through platforms, solid platform sides, and movement locks for shield and grab states. Record any new rule in docs/design/DECISIONS.md and add boundary tests.
Independently review movement timing, state transitions, collision edge cases, frame-rate dependence, and deterministic tests against docs/design/MOVEMENT_SPEC.md.

Extend the data-driven combat (scripts/combat, scripts/core/MatchSimulation.gd) with shielding, shield break, grabs and throws, specials, and directional influence according to docs/design/COMBAT_SPEC.md. Keep all knockback math in KnockbackModel and contact ordering stable; add tests for each rule.
Review combat resolution, simultaneous hits, repeated-hit prevention, shield and grab rules, knockback, hitstun, stocks, respawn, and match completion.

Implement Captain America and Batman prototype data/resources and the original Aegis Rooftop stage. Keep global simulation rules generic and put character-specific behavior behind validated data or isolated scripts.
Integrate two local players, character selection or configured fighter loading, Aegis Rooftop, camera, HUD, stocks, respawn, pause, restart, debug hitboxes, and a launchable main scene.

Run the complete test suite and headless validation. Verify the clean-checkout path, missing-resource behavior, deterministic simulation, match lifecycle, and documented limitations. Do not modify gameplay code.

checks.name: Godot headless load, compile, and boot validation
